purpose: Registered content body descriptors, inline ciphertext bodies, direct body pins, download grants, durable grant-expiry cursors, GC epochs and GC candidates. Every customer-content partition is workspace scoped; session filesystem roots and pages do not live here.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: A dedicated content CMK, distinct from every other regional table (R-SECRETS). The key policy requires kms:EncryptionContext:aex:workspace to equal the caller workspace on Encrypt, Decrypt and GenerateDataKey (OD-18).

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_gc
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: One index serves both mark (enumerate every registered body in 256 bounded buckets per workspace) and sweep (enumerate candidates). There is deliberately no reverse owner index and no reference count (R-DELETE): pin removal is a DeleteItem on a known key.

globalSecondaryIndexes.name: gsi_expiry
globalSecondaryIndexes.rationale: Download grants are spread over sixty-four due partitions. The expiry worker queries bounded due pages and atomically removes each expired grant with its known pin; it never scans the authority or trusts TTL timing.

stream.rationale: KEYS_ONLY because the table holds ciphertext bodies; a NEW_IMAGE stream would duplicate every inline body into stream storage and into the pipe role blast radius. Storage usage facts ride regional-work transactionally instead.

timeToLive.rationale: Grant pins and grant state rows only, at expiry plus a 3600 second grace. GC never trusts it: GC re-reads expiresAt and refuses to delete a body whose grant pin has not provably expired.
